recommendedCareers.title: Medical Doctor (MBBS)
recommendedCareers.whySuit: This aligns directly with the student's explicit goal of becoming a doctor and their strong interest in medicine. Their ability to understand and memorise biological processes provides a solid foundation for medical studies.
recommendedCareers.degree: Complete Class 12 with emphasis on Biology, then prepare for JEE Main and NEET for medical college admission, followed by MD/MD-Pharm course
nextSteps: Focus on strengthening Biology and Chemistry in Class 12 and begin preparing for JEE Main syllabus

recommendedCareers.title: Dental Surgery (BDS)
recommendedCareers.whySuit: While not the primary goal, dental surgery also involves patient care and requires strong scientific knowledge. It offers a complementary healthcare path that values hands-on work with people and builds on the student's interest in medicine and biology.
recommendedCareers.degree: Complete Class 12, then appear for JEE Main and NEET for dental admissions (DINB/PDS routes)
nextSteps: Start focusing on Biology and Chemistry for both MBBS and BDS preparation

alternativeCareers.title: Pharmacy
alternativeCareers.note: A healthcare profession focused on drug management and pharmacy services. While distinct from direct patient care, it complements medical interests and requires strong chemistry and biology foundations.

alternativeCareers.title: Nursing
alternativeCareers.note: Involves direct patient care and requires compassion and communication skills. Though typically pursued after graduation, it remains a viable alternative to consider alongside medicine.

profileSummary: A Class 12 student in the BiPC stream with a clear interest in medicine and a goal to become a doctor. They excel at memorizing and understanding biological processes, and their favorite subjects are Biology and Chemistry.
keyObservations: The student is pursuing the BiPC stream with Biology, Physics, and Chemistry as preferred subjects

They prefer work involving human interaction and patient care
Biology and Chemistry are listed as their favourite subjects

strongestRecommendation.reason: This is the student's explicit career goal and matches their strong interest in medicine and biological processes. Becoming a doctor aligns perfectly with their passion for helping patients through medical practice.

actionPlan: Strengthen Biology and Chemistry in Class 12 curriculum
Begin regular revision of NCERT textbooks for both subjects
Register for JEE Main preparation and create a structured study schedule
Take mock tests to assess readiness for NEET
Explore local medical colleges and counseling processes early
